jordan.h: Hey team — customer (Brightline) reporting vectors/sec ~60% below baseline since ~02:15 UTC, tokens/sec unchanged. They see 200 OK for token calls but 5xx/429 for /embeddings intermittently. attaching sample logs.
maya.s: Thx. Any auth failures in the window? Could be rate-limits or billing spikes.
jordan.h: Quick grep shows intermittent 401s from embed-worker proxied as 502s downstream. snippet:
```
2026-03-12T02:16:22Z embed-worker request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_status=401 service=billing
2026-03-12T02:16:23Z embed-worker request_id=abc124 queued_ms=3400 processing_ms=12 batch_size=1
```
liam.p: 401 upstream from billing service => means token validation failing sporadically. But why do tokens/sec stay stable? Could be auth middleware rejecting some requests causing retries and queue saturation for vectors pipeline.
maya.s: Can you confirm if client saw retries or increased latency on the SDK? those can amplify load.
jordan.h: Customer logs show SDK retry spikes: backoff loop 3x per request for some users. They said bursty traffic pattern at 02:15.
ops-bot: Noted. I checked metrics: embedding_queue_depth spiked from 12 -> 78 at 02:17 and GPU_util dropped from 82% -> 45% at same time.
liam.p: That suggests workers were blocked waiting on auth/billing responses, so batches never formed (small batch_size=1) — vectors/sec drops while tokens/sec (non-batched) unaffected.
maya.s: What changed around 02:15? Any deploys or billing rollouts?
billing-bot: @channel Billing had a config push at 02:12 to roll out a cache invalidation TTL change for auth tokens to improve freshness. 10% of auth cache nodes were restarted during the rollout.
jordan.h: Aha. Cache restart led to auth validation hitting DB and occasional 401s while caches warmed. Clients retried, but retries saturated embed queue.
liam.p: Repro plan: emulate burst traffic with disabled auth cache to see queue behavior. repro steps for eng-runbook:
1) On staging, flip env BILLING_AUTH_CACHE_TTL=0
2) Run embedding load: hey loadgen --endpoint /embeddings --qps 120 --batch-target 64 --size 512
3) Monitor embedding_queue_depth and batch_size metrics
4) Watch for upstream 401s and SDK retries
jordan.h: I ran quick smoke on a node: when auth cache cold, median batch_size fell to 2 and vectors/sec dropped ~58%.
maya.s: Mitigation for prod: rollback TTL change or pause rollout to affected nodes. Also add fast-fail to client retries when upstream auth 401 to avoid hammering.
liam.p: Long-term: make embedding pipeline resilient to auth validation latency — let auth checks be async for already-enqueued requests when safe, or add backpressure token so batches can form.
ops-bot: Action items created: #INC-2026 - pause billing TTL rollout (assigned billing team), #SRE-emb-2026 - add retry fast-fail logic (assigned liam.p). Notifying customer.
jordan.h: Shared repro and customer-facing summary with Brightline; they asked for ETA on rollback.
maya.s: Rolling back now; I expect cache nodes to warm in ~5min. Will update.
jordan.h: Customer confirmed vectors/sec recovering after ~6m. Closing loop once post-mortem done.
liam.p: I'll draft postmortem: root cause = billing auth cache rollout causing intermittent 401s -> client retries -> queue saturation -> reduced batching -> drop in vectors/sec. Proposed fixes list included.
maya.s: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
